About WebGradients | Free CSS Gradients and Color Tools
GitHub - itmeo/webgradients: 180 free CSS3, Figma, Sketch & PSD gradients — plus a JSON dataset for design tools, generators, and AI agents.

name: WebGradients
summary: Collection of 180 free CSS linear gradients with copy-ready CSS3 code, plus a color-palette catalogue and design-tool packs.
description: A free collection of 180 named CSS linear gradients you can copy into any part of a site, each with CSS3 code, start/end hex colors and a PNG export. Includes a palette catalogue (200 palettes and 200 examples extracted from real websites) plus Sketch, Photoshop and Figma packs.
contains: CSS3 code, hex color pairs and PNG export per gradient
JSON dataset for design tools and AI agents
free for commercial and personal use with no attribution
